title: rigops config
description: Configuration for rigops. All paths accept ~ and $VAR expansion.

transcripts_dir.description: Root directory of Claude Code project transcripts.

ledger.description: Settings for the rigops ledger (weekly effectiveness rows).

watch_projects.description: Map of project name to its transcripts sub-path, watched by the ledger.

fixed_tax.description: Always-loaded config counted toward the fixed context tax.

paths.description: Explicit file paths counted toward the fixed tax.

globs.description: Glob patterns counted toward the fixed tax.

context.description: Settings for the plugin's context-nudge hook and statusline.

nudge_tiers.description: Ascending context-token thresholds (low/heavy/critical) that trigger the ctx-nudge hook and color the statusline.

rearm_tokens.description: Token climb, past the lowest tier, required to re-fire the ctx-nudge hook.

doctor.description: Settings for `rigops doctor` (job fleet health watchdog).

registry.description: Path to the rigops.v1 registry markdown file.

label_prefix.description: Launchd label prefixes tried, in order, when a registry item has no explicit plist.

kill_grace_s.description: Seconds to wait after SIGTERM before SIGKILL on a hung job.

heal_cooldown_h.description: Hours to suppress a repeat kickstart of the same job after healing it.

checks.description: Generic fleet-wide checks, independent of the registry.

custom.description: Shell commands checked by exit code.

disk_free.description: Disk-free threshold check, or null to skip it.

notify_command.description: Shell command run with the report path appended; empty to skip notifications.
